name: Readiness, Liveness & Health
description: Readiness, Liveness & Health standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-BE-HEALTH applies.

rules.title: Separate liveness from readiness
rules.detail: Liveness answers whether the process should be restarted; readiness answers whether it can safely receive traffic.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Separate liveness from readiness.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Separate liveness from readiness.

rules.title: Do not make liveness depend on every downstream service
rules.detail: A dependency outage should not cause restart loops unless the process itself cannot recover.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Do not make liveness depend on every downstream service.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Do not make liveness depend on every downstream service.

rules.title: Readiness checks only dependencies required to serve traffic
rules.detail: Critical startup/configuration and required dependencies may block readiness; optional dependencies report degraded state separately.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Readiness checks only dependencies required to serve traffic.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Readiness checks only dependencies required to serve traffic.

rules.title: Keep health endpoints lightweight and safe
rules.detail: Checks have short timeouts, avoid expensive full transactions and do not expose secrets or internal topology publicly.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Keep health endpoints lightweight and safe.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Keep health endpoints lightweight and safe.

rules.title: Expose build/version and degradation diagnostics safely
rules.detail: Operators can correlate health with deployed version and dependency status through authenticated/internal diagnostics.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Expose build/version and degradation diagnostics safely.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Expose build/version and degradation diagnostics safely.

rules.title: Test health behavior during dependency failure and startup
rules.detail: Deployment/orchestration tests verify expected ready/not-ready/live transitions.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Test health behavior during dependency failure and startup.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Test health behavior during dependency failure and startup.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-BE-HEALTH applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Readiness, Liveness & Health to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Readiness, Liveness & Health is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Readiness, Liveness & Health failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
